desc: A long walk north of the lit ash tree. A worn market town of two houses. The worn temple and the damaged market hall each stand alone of their kind. The workshops. A light lies on an ash tree that nothing casts. Green shoots. Here: bones, pack and staff. The damaged wayside shrine to the south (middle).

features.name: the workshops
features.note: Not enterable: "You can't see any workshop from here." A general feature, like the home village's square.

features.name: bones, pack, staff
features.note: Not examinable ("You see no pack here"), like the mound's grave goods.

name: Worn waystation
notes: Reached with "go to waystation". "Bones, pack and staff" reads like the remains of a traveller, listed like the mound's grave goods.
statusNote: Looked until it repeated. Temple, market hall, workshops, houses all unexplored.
